nodes.label: Mate der Untoten: Guía de los easter eggs
nodes.rationale: Print (A4) PDF source for the per-map EE guide; deliberately gives only steps (what + where) and leaves story, bosses, weapons and endings to be discovered by playing.

nodes.label: Mate of the Dead (Capítulo III, penal)
Monumento al Mate (Capítulo VII, mapa bonus)
Horno de barro (empanadas, canasta de la Pulpería)
Escudo (tres piezas + mesa, Z adelante)
nodes.rationale: Shield parts are team-owned so one player collecting them is enough.

nodes.label: Encierros (fire-curtain lockdowns)
nodes.rationale: All players must be inside the zone or the lockdown does not start, so nobody is left out of a co-op step.

nodes.label: Jefe de ronda (every 5 rounds; esteros from 8)
Evento cada 10 rondas (forced during the EE)
nodes.rationale: Every map but the torre has a big round-10 event and the EE always triggers one early if none has happened yet.

nodes.label: Canción secreta (three hidden collectibles per map)
Arma especial del molino (calabaza, bombilla, yerba; mesa del curandero)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory for the EE: cemetery souls only count when killed with it.

nodes.label: Noche de la Luz Mala (molino round-10 event)
Arma especial de La Tapera (hoja, mango, virola; morsa del Galpón)
La defensa del yerbal (La Tapera round-10 event)
Torres de mate (auto-turrets, cebar with F)
Kit de ácido (penal wonder weapon conversion)
Algarrobo de los Colgados (esteros EE hub)
La luz de los ahogados (only Gil carries it)
Martín Fierro (guide NPC, torre and castillo)
Cañón de la Vuelta de Obligado (caño, rueda, mecha)
Noche del Remolino (torre special round every 7)
Puente levadizo y termas (castillo Pack-a-Pava prep)
Cuatro armas especiales elementales (fuego, viento, rayo, hielo)
nodes.rationale: Anyone can take one but only one at a time; it returns to its altar if the holder dies, leaves or swaps it.

Seis cuadernos (portal secret, Sala de las Banderas)
